studentJourney.title: Welcome!
studentJourney.studentText: Hello, friend! Today we will learn about 1/2 and 1/4. Are you ready?
studentJourney.owlText: Hello! I am OWL. Let us learn about 1/2 and 1/4 together!

studentJourney.title: Our Mission
studentJourney.studentText: By the end of this lesson, you will understand 1/2 and 1/4 better!
studentJourney.owlText: Our mission is to explore 1/2 and 1/4 together.

studentJourney.title: Think First!
studentJourney.studentText: Before we start, think about this: What do you already know about 1/2 and 1/4?
studentJourney.owlText: Take a moment to think about what you already know.

interaction.prompt: What do you know about 1/2 and 1/4?

studentJourney.title: Learn It
studentJourney.studentText: Today we will learn about fractions. A fraction is a part of a whole. A half (1/2) means one of two equal parts.
studentJourney.owlText: Here is what you need to know.

studentJourney.title: Real Life Connection
studentJourney.studentText: Where do you see 1/2 and 1/4 at home or school?
studentJourney.owlText: We use this knowledge every day!

studentJourney.title: Watch and Learn
studentJourney.studentText: Let me show you how 1/2 and 1/4 works. Follow along!
studentJourney.owlText: Watch this example, then you will try.

studentJourney.title: Your Turn!
studentJourney.studentText: Practice: Draw a circle and shade half. Draw a rectangle and shade a quarter.

interaction.question: What is a half?
interaction.explanation: Correct! A half is one of two equal parts.

studentJourney.title: Think About Learning
studentJourney.studentText: What did you learn about 1/2 and 1/4 today? Write your answer below.

studentJourney.title: Well Done!
studentJourney.studentText: Congratulations! You completed the lesson about 1/2 and 1/4!
